e.g. Engineer asked for extra cash on-site to swap parts.
Tell EquipSeva your side of the story. Admin reviews both before deciding release vs refund. You can only respond once — make it count.
e.g. Replaced the failing PCB on-site, hospital signed off the work order, photos uploaded.
